data.name: Jithin
data.gender_notes: Jithin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jithin is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'jith' meaning 'victory' or 'success'. In Hindu mythology, Jithin is a name for Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. The name Jithin carries the meaning “Victory, Success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jithin usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner victory over challenges and the outer victory in material success.
data.etymology: Jithin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jithin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jithin is found in various ancient Hindu texts, including the Puranas and Itihasas. It carries the connotation of winning over challenges and obstacles, and is associated with triumph over adversity. The name is also commonly given to children as a sign of hope and encouragement, symbolizing the belief that the child will succeed and overcome any difficulties that may come their way.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Lord Vishnu is the embodiment of divine love, preservation, and protection. As Jithin, He is the giver of victory and success, and is revered as the one who helps his devotees overcome hardships and achieve their goals. The name serves as a constant reminder of the power of prayers and devotion, and inspires the bearer to stay strong and focused in the face of challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jithin signifies the victorious spirit within an individual. It represents the innate ability to overcome challenges and emerge victorious, just like the sun rising after a stormy night.
